newsitem.title: UK: Algeria, lifters agree raised gas oil premium.
newsitem.headline: Algeria, lifters agree raised gas oil premium.

text.p: Algerian state oil company Sonatrach and lifters have agreed a raised price for low sulphur gas oil to be delivered in August, traders said on Wednesday.
The agreement is for a premium of $1.50 to the formula, which is based on diesel prices in northern Europe and the Mediterranean, they said. Sonatrach obtained a $1 discount to the formula in July.
The company is expected to deliver seven or eight cargoes in August. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 7646
